messages:
Maya: Hey team — Cliffside customer private window is tonight 2028-06-15 23:00–00:30 UTC. I'll run the deploy. High level: push model artifacts, run online DB migration (backwards-compatible), update firewall for customer VPN. Need smoke owner and rollback owners. tagging @Ashwin @Lia @Devon for sync.

Ashwin: Oncall here. I'll own infra and networking. Is the migration zero-downtime or do we need a maintenance page?

Lia: It's an online/compatible migration. PR #4523 contains the alter and backfill logic; feature flag ensures old code continues to work. I'll be smoke lead unless someone else volunteers.

Devon: I'll handle customer comms and the VPN cutover. Customer asked if we can ramp traffic slowly after smoke.

Maya: Plan: start deploy 23:00 UTC — push model tag, then run migration at 23:05 (feature flag on), smoke 23:10–23:20. Ramp traffic 23:20–23:30. Rollback plan: revert model tag + flip feature flag off; DB is backward-compatible (no destructive rollback). Rollback owners: Lia (app/feature flag), Ashwin (networking).

Ashwin: Noted. I've opened INF-7890 for the firewall change; rule will be inserted to allow the customer VPN CIDR. I'll monitor propagation and be ready to revert.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: cliffside-20280615-2300 initiated by Maya. Precheck window opens 23:00 UTC.

Maya: Pre-deploy checklist (copied from runbook):
```
- confirm backup snapshot exists: s3://backups/cliffside/20280615
- PR #4523 approved and merged
- INF-7890 merged and applied
- smoke owner: Lia
- rollback owners: Lia (app), Ashwin (net)
- monitoring dash: /dash/cliffside-model (latency, 5xx, kv-miss)
```

Lia: :thumbsup: I can run the smoke tests. Which queries and traces do you want me to paste if anything fails?

Maya: Watch for latency >300ms on api/generate, error rate >0.5%, and KV miss rate spike. Use trace id prefix `cliffside-2028-06-15` when creating tickets. If anything looks odd, tag `#eng-oncall` and call Ashwin.

Devon: I'll ask the customer to start test traffic at 5 rps for 5m, then 20 rps. Will confirm VPN cutover time (aiming 23:05).

Ashwin: I'll keep the runbook INF-runbook open and monitor BGP + firewall logs. If rule push fails, I can revert to previous ACL in ~2m.

Maya: Runbook link: /docs/runbooks/cliffside-deploy.md — rolling restart steps and post-deploy validations are listed there.

Lia: ACK. I'll report smoke pass/fail here.

Maya: Starting now (23:00 UTC) — pushing model artifact and creating release tag. Will report each step.

Maya: model tag pushed, release created.

Ashwin: firewall rule applied, propagation looks good on our edge nodes.

Maya: migration started (23:05). feature flag enabled after backfill starts.

Lia: Running api-smoke, kv-checks, and end-to-end sample flows now.

Lia: smoke: api-smoke OK, kv-checks OK, sample flows OK — no increased 5xx or latency. All clear.

Ashwin: Network checks stable. No error spikes in firewall logs.

Devon: Customer confirmed VPN cutover and initial 5 rps ramp succeeded. Moving to 20 rps.

Maya: Deploy complete, smoke green. Rolling window success — closing out. Thanks everyone. :tada:

Lia: Nice work. Leaving notes in PR and runbook.

Ashwin: I'll close INF-7890 after one more propagation check.

Devon: Customer happy. I'll send final confirmation email.

Maya: Closing thread — will attach post-deploy notes to /docs/runbooks/cliffside-deploy.md and the PR.
